The first line asks where the books are, so it ends with a question mark. The second tells of a discovery: a full stop is a calm observation and an exclamation mark is an excited one. Both discoveries work equally well. A question mark would make the discovery uncertain, outside this scene.
Both requests must hold: apples + pears = 9, and apples = 2 × pears. Check the total and the relationship separately.
11 × 8 = 88; 12 × 12 = 144; 7 × 7 = 49. The two 88 cards are interchangeable. Check the requested quantities and operations separately.

These specifies lanterns and the specifies path, so both are determiners. Us refers to the owners; They refers back to the lanterns. Those are pronouns here.
Accept means agree to receive the parcel, consistent with returning it only when the label does not match. Except means leave out or exclude; that does not express receiving the matching delivery.
